url.title: URL
url.description: Final public URL represented by the saved row.

requestedUrl.title: Requested URL
requestedUrl.description: Normalized URL requested before any public redirect.

statusCode.title: Status
statusCode.description: HTTP status code returned for this URL.

statusText.title: Status text
statusText.description: HTTP response status text when supplied.

contentType.title: Content type
contentType.description: Response Content-Type header captured during the crawl.

indexability.title: Indexability
indexability.description: High-level indexability decision from response and directives.

indexabilityStatus.title: Indexability detail
indexabilityStatus.description: Specific status such as OK, noindex, or Redirected.

title.title: Title
title.description: HTML title element extracted from the fetched page.

titleLength.title: Title length
titleLength.description: Character count of the extracted HTML title.

metaDescription.title: Meta description
metaDescription.description: Content of the page meta description tag.
metaDescription.example: This domain is for use in illustrative examples.

metaDescriptionLength.title: Meta description length
metaDescriptionLength.description: Character count of the extracted meta description.

metaKeywords.title: Meta keywords
metaKeywords.description: Content of the legacy meta keywords tag.

metaRobots.title: Meta robots
metaRobots.description: Robots directives declared in an HTML meta tag.

xRobotsTag.title: X-Robots-Tag
xRobotsTag.description: Robots directives declared in the HTTP response header.

canonicalUrl.title: Canonical URL
canonicalUrl.description: Resolved canonical link target found in page HTML.

h1.title: First H1
h1.description: First unique H1 text extracted from the page.

h1Secondary.title: Second H1
h1Secondary.description: Second unique H1 text when the page has multiple H1s.

h1Count.title: H1 count
h1Count.description: Number of H1 elements present in the fetched HTML.

h2.title: First H2
h2.description: First unique H2 text extracted from the page.

h2Count.title: H2 count
h2Count.description: Number of H2 elements present in the fetched HTML.

htmlLang.title: HTML language
htmlLang.description: Value of the root html lang attribute.

wordCount.title: Visible word count
wordCount.description: Approximate visible body-word count after non-content tags are removed.

textRatioPct.title: Text ratio percent
textRatioPct.description: Approximate visible text percentage of the response HTML.

sizeBytes.title: Response bytes
sizeBytes.description: Byte length of the response body processed by the crawler.

crawlDepth.title: Crawl depth
crawlDepth.description: Link-hop depth from the source seed URL.

inlinks.title: Inlinks from crawled set
inlinks.description: Inlinks to this URL from other rows in the saved crawl set.

uniqueInlinks.title: Unique inlinks
uniqueInlinks.description: Distinct crawled pages linking to this URL.

outlinks.title: Outlinks
outlinks.description: Total on-page internal and external href count.

uniqueOutlinks.title: Unique outlinks
uniqueOutlinks.description: Distinct normalized href targets from this page.

internalOutlinks.title: Internal outlinks
internalOutlinks.description: On-page links inside the configured source domain.

externalOutlinks.title: External outlinks
externalOutlinks.description: On-page links outside the configured source domain.

imageCount.title: Images
imageCount.description: Number of img elements discovered in the page HTML.

imagesMissingAlt.title: Images missing alt
imagesMissingAlt.description: Count of img elements without non-empty alt text.

redirectUrl.title: Redirect target
redirectUrl.description: Observed redirect target when the request redirected.

redirectChain.title: Redirect chain
redirectChain.description: Observed redirect targets encountered for the request.

schemaTypes.title: JSON-LD types
schemaTypes.description: Unique schema.org JSON-LD @type values on the page.

ogTitle.title: Open Graph title
ogTitle.description: Open Graph title metadata extracted from the page.

ogDescription.title: Open Graph description
ogDescription.description: Open Graph description metadata extracted from the page.

twitterCard.title: Twitter card
twitterCard.description: Twitter card type metadata from the page.

hreflangCount.title: Hreflang count
hreflangCount.description: Number of alternate hreflang links in the page.

viewport.title: Viewport
viewport.description: Viewport meta tag value found in the document.

charset.title: Charset
charset.description: Charset declaration from the page metadata.

contentHash.title: Content hash
contentHash.description: Short hash of extracted page content for run comparison.

issueFlags.title: Issue flags
issueFlags.description: Machine-readable on-page SEO flags for this URL.

issueCount.title: Issue count
issueCount.description: Number of machine-readable issue flags on this row.

startUrl.title: Source seed URL
startUrl.description: Original public seed URL that led to this row.

crawlScope.title: Crawl scope
crawlScope.description: Configured link-following scope for this row's crawl.

scrapedAt.title: Collected at
scrapedAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when this crawl result was saved.
